design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (overpayment_waiver_and_recovery).

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed: {"task": 1, "key": "env_0049_state_unemployment_insurance_agency/overpayment_waiver_and_recovery/1", "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [6, 5, 5]}. Assignment: waiver decision 6 factors, household-income completion 5, plan change (root) 5 -> multiset {6,5,5}.

[Why this is a good test] A claimant only wants her monthly plan payment lowered. The plan-change rule waits on a decision for every waiver request on the overpayment, and the decision rule waits on the request carrying a household annual income above zero. Her request (lodged 2025-09-19) is under review with income 0.00, so the agent must notice the review (status waiver_pending), read the request, have her complete it with an income worked out from the Department's claim and withholding records under five counting rules, decide the waiver under six rules, and only then compute the changed installment under five more. Every step is reading policy, querying records of three products and calculating; one tool per problem.

[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: overpay_ext_returned_payment_fee, overpay_ext_plan_arrears, overpay_ext_plan_reinstatement, overpay_ext_new_plan_installment and their tools (fee booking, arrears payment, reinstatement, new plan). Claimed here: overpay_ext_waiver_household_income (complete_waiver_household_income_abba3816, user), overpay_ext_waiver_decision (record_waiver_decision_07f617be, agent), overpay_ext_plan_change (change_repayment_plan_f1933d01, user). Disjoint from task 0; together the two tasks cover all seven extended policies. The waiver events (review, granted/partially granted/denied, waiver adjustment) and the plan-set event are used without any write into another category (the waiver adjustment triggers nothing outside overpay).

[Problem-tree card] Root overpay_ext_plan_change (user). Edges:
 (e1) plan change -> waiver decision: value_input, gate balance, form state, affirmative: "A plan's monthly installment is changed only after every waiver request lodged on the overpayment carries a decision." Ordering connective "only after"; record-visible state (request status / review); no tool or code token; scope "every waiver request". Only the waiver-decision write moves a request off received. False at opening: initial_state.overpay_waiver_requests.141b733e-e124-4e32-89a6-b8c2b5a9bfe7.request_status = received, initial_state.overpayments.958173a6-276a-4cb2-a6bd-923239bf5747.status = waiver_pending. Skip -> changed installment 76.67 instead of 32.42.
 (e2) waiver decision -> income completion: value_input, gate household_income, form state, negated: "A waiver decision is not recorded until the waiver request under review carries a household annual income above zero." Only the completion write puts an income on a lodged request. False at opening: initial_state.overpay_waiver_requests.141b733e-e124-4e32-89a6-b8c2b5a9bfe7.annual_household_income = 0.0. Skip -> income percent 0, whole waivable principal 1,686.67 waived (partially granted: above zero but less than the whole unpaid principal 2,300.00) instead of 1,619.20.
 Order: income completion (step 11) -> decision (13) -> change (15). Two value-input edges (>= max(2-1,1)). Owner=user: the completion (her own application) and the change (her own agreement). The two sentences run in opposite directions, each the way the desk states it.

[Base-invariant card] Completion (subject overpay_waiver_review_opened): overpay_waiver gates waiver_request_window (time; anchor overpayments.determination_date 2025-08-25, window 30 calendar days counted from the next day, request received 2025-09-19 = day 25, inclusive boundary 2025-09-24), waiver_eligible_classification (Employer Reporting Error is waiver-eligible), claimant_lodged_request (request 141b733e-e124-4e32-89a6-b8c2b5a9bfe7 on 958173a6-276a-4cb2-a6bd-923239bf5747, received). Decision (subjects waiver adjusted/granted/partially granted/denied): waiver_eligible_classification. Change (overpay_repayment_plan_set): plan_on_open_debt, satisfied only after step 13 returns the overpayment to in_recovery (evidence prior_step:13). Overwrites declared: the waiver policy's decision sentence (share and waivable principal are refined) and the plan installment sentence.

[Business-object card] Overpayment 958173a6-276a-4cb2-a6bd-923239bf5747 (Employer Reporting Error; claim 7163a8ea-ec97-4877-a295-1d600c6e4039; weeks 2025-03-08..2025-06-14 paid at 572.00 instead of the redetermined 412.00; principal 2,400.00; 100.00 card repayment 2025-09-02; plan 50.00 first due 2025-09-26; waiver request 141b733e-e124-4e32-89a6-b8c2b5a9bfe7). Claim 7163a8ea-ec97-4877-a295-1d600c6e4039: redetermination (determination 2) dated 2025-05-20; payments through 2025-08-05 plus the 62.00 supplemental of 2025-08-12 for week 2025-07-19; certifications with earnings 682.00/31h from late July, holiday pay 176.00 on the week ending 2025-09-06. Withholding: current child-support order a5383cb2-6395-4dc8-ad8a-48088138dc1e 30.00/week, federal election 6fb04a7c-5216-47cc-8640-8e8ff3e885e0 with 10% deductions on every payment.

[Factor card]
 income 31,701.20 (baseline 36,024.00): benefit_payment_dating [cross claim] supplemental in window -> week-of-benefit dating (32,849.20) - near-miss: the 2025-07-22 payment was issued inside the window but pays for a week before it; earned_income_deduction [cross claim] average 29.69 h -> 5% (33,398.00); support_order_exclusion [cross withhold] 1,560.00 (33,261.20); other_pay_addition [cross claim] holiday pay 176.00 (31,525.20); withheld_tax_exclusion [cross withhold] 94.00 (31,795.20).
 waiver 1,619.20 (baseline 1,150.00 = 50% of 2,300.00): overpaid_period_reliance 15 weeks +0.10 (1,416.80); part_time_work_while_certifying [multi-source: recent earnings AND claim active; cross claim] +0.10 (1,416.80); good_faith_repayment +0.05 (1,518.00); slow_determination +0.05 (1,518.00); partial_band_position x1.20 (1,349.33); redetermination_notice_cutoff [cross claim] 11/15 of the principal (2,208.00) - near-miss: the four weeks after 2025-05-20 look like ordinary overpaid weeks but were paid after the notice.
 change 32.42 (baseline 25.00): remaining_principal_months 12 (25.00); hardship_band_months +6 (45.39); review_months_given_back +1 (34.04); running_schedule_anchor -1, one installment fallen due since 2025-09-26 (30.95); waiver_size_months +3 (37.83).

[Persona design] Friendly, anxious, slightly over-explaining pharmacy technician; volunteers only the goal (lower the 50-dollar monthly payment). Conditional reactions: when told the form lacks the yearly income she cannot give a figure and asks for the records figure, then confirms it when handed the step; relieved at the decision; agrees to the new amount as given; ends after confirmation. Facts on request: lives alone, no other income, child support 30 dollars a week.

[Standard solution] find_customers -> verify -> find_overpayments -> find_overpay_waiver_requests -> find_overpay_ledger -> find_claims -> find_claim_certifications -> find_claim_ledger -> find_withholding_orders -> find_withholding_ledger -> unlock/call completion 31,701.20 (user) -> unlock/call decision partially_granted 1,619.20 (agent) -> unlock/call change 32.42 (user).

[Verification] Recomputed with the gate engine on the handling-time worlds (real tool replay): income 31701.2, waiver 1619.2, change 32.42; skip checks: decision without income 1686.67, change without decision 76.67. Gate runs are recorded below.

[Revision log] check_compute --task 1 first failed: "overpay_ext_waiver_household_income history is NOT load-bearing" - the completion read only LATEST values of its own request, so zeroing own-history aggregates changed nothing. Root cause: the rule's scope (only a request still awaiting decision is completed) was not in compute. Change: added the sentence "a request no longer awaiting decision is not completed and keeps the income it carries" to the rule and baseline paragraph, and the binding requests_under_review = COUNT of received requests gating the result. Re-run: COMPUTE OK; values unchanged.

[Gate runs — final, difficulty-wide, repository root]
check_extended.py -> EXTENDED OK; check_task_tools.py -> TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK (7 tools).
replay_tasks.py -> 1.json 16 actions, deterministic, non-vacuous, 0 errors, closure 109 = initial 109; REPLAY OK.
check_solvability.py -> 1.json verify True, 3 calls, 5 base gates (including the waiver-window time gate with its temporal_feasibility entry), 3 seed rows; SOLVABILITY OK.
check_compute.py -> 1.json 3 computations, 16 factors, 7 cross-difficulty, history rows 8, branches 71, 16 steps, match True; COMPUTE OK.
check_grounding.py -> GROUNDING OK; check_cross_fire.py -> SCOPE OK; check_cache_diff.py -> INFO only.
validate_scenario -> only the "required document ... not found" errors for the three policy ids (KB not yet rendered).

[Manual value gates] Length: lower the payment -> request still under review (plan-change sentence) -> request lacks the income (decision sentence); breadth across the request, the overpayment ledger and holding dates, the claim's payments, certifications and redetermination, and the withholding orders and deductions. Owner=user: completing her own application and agreeing to the changed plan, both done on the call. Time gate: determination 2025-08-25, 30-day window counted from 2025-08-26, request 2025-09-19 (day 25) - timely; 2025-09-24 would be the last timely day, 2025-09-25 late. The persona states no income figure and never names the waiver; the decision outcome (partially granted) follows from 202.56% alone. Draft recomputation from visible text reproduces 31,701.20 / 1,619.20 / 32.42.


[Rework round 2 — policy-task audit items] G-1/F1-1: plan change determination_clock replaced by running_schedule_anchor, a genuine anchor method (first installment due date passed -> take off installments fallen due, MONTHS(first due, now) + 1; recorded but not yet passed -> whole months since the determination, capped; none recorded -> nothing). Here 2025-09-26 has passed -> 1, result 32.42 unchanged. G-2: month ladders are shares of the classification maximum (plan change 0.20/0.40 -> 12/24/60 here, unchanged). G-5: pension tier adds the latest in-window weekly amount of each pension kind (not exercised: no pension). G-6: the rule dates the overpaid period from the Sunday six days before the first week-ending date; compute uses DAYS < -6 for 'before' (notice 2025-05-20 within period: 11 of 15 weeks, unchanged). G-7/O-4/F1-2: income completion applies only to a request recorded with 0.00 income (no figure stated); a stated figure stands and the confirmed figure becomes the claimant's own statement; the decision prerequisite now reads 'carries a household annual income above zero', matching its condition; plan-change condition no longer adds the overpayment-status clause. G-8: a request is granted only when the whole unpaid principal is waived, otherwise partially granted (tool docstring aligned); here partially_granted unchanged. O-6/F1-3: support_order_exclusion and other_pay_addition relabelled method; partial_band_position relabelled parameter. O-7: the income rule states the completion is made only on a request whose review is already open. Values unchanged: 31,701.20 / 1,619.20 / 32.42. All gates re-run green.

[Rework round 3 — revision_2 audit items] R2-G-12/F1-1: running_schedule_anchor now has three tiers every one of which a customer with a current plan can reach: first installment due date passed and no waiver request lodged after it -> installments fallen due to the handling date (MONTHS(first due, now) + 1); first due passed and a waiver request lodged after it -> installments fallen due before the review, MONTHS(first due, latest request date) + 1 (billing stops during review); first due not yet passed -> the determination's clock, whole months since the determination capped at the cap. Here the first due 2025-09-26 has passed and the only request (2025-09-19) predates it -> tier 1, 1 taken off; baseline 0 gives 30.95; 32.42 unchanged. R2-G-11/F1-4: remaining_principal_months ladder values now read K('small_remainder_share') / K('mid_remainder_share') of the classification maximum, the same branches as compute (12 here). R2-O-13: the decision rule names a request with nothing waived as denied, partially granted only for an amount above zero but below the whole unpaid principal (docstring aligned); here partially_granted unchanged. R2-O-12: 0.00 is now worded as the record of a request lodged without any income figure. Values unchanged: 31,701.20 / 1,619.20 / 32.42.
user_scenario:
You are Leontyne Abernathy-Solberg, a 37-year-old pharmacy technician in Ashby Falls. You live alone, and you pay child support for your son, who lives with his father. You were laid off in February, drew unemployment through the spring, and since July you have been working about 31 hours a week at a pharmacy while still filing your weekly claims. In August the Department told you that you had been overpaid because your old employer reported your wages wrong, and at the end of August you agreed to pay 50 dollars a month on it. You are calling because 50 dollars a month is more than you can manage right now, and you want your monthly payment on that overpayment lowered; you are ready to agree to a lower amount today.

You are friendly but anxious about money, and you tend to over-explain a little. You give your details only when you are asked: your phone number is 6085552384, the last four digits of your Social Security number are 2753, your date of birth is 1988-07-14, your ZIP code is 53731, and your email is leontyne.abernathysolberg@gmail.com. If you are asked who lives with you, it is just you. If you are asked about income, you have no other income besides the pharmacy job and the unemployment you were paid, and the child support you pay is 30 dollars a week, taken by the state.

If the representative tells you that a form you sent in is missing your yearly household income, you say that you honestly do not have a yearly figure, because you were on unemployment and then started at the pharmacy, and you ask them to work it out from what the Department has on record; when they tell you the figure and hand you the step to put it on your form, you confirm it as given. If they tell you that a decision on your form has reduced what you owe, you are relieved and thank them.

When the representative tells you the new monthly amount and hands you the step to agree to it, you agree to it as given. You never suggest amounts yourself, you do not ask for the whole debt to be forgiven, and you do not bring up anything else. As soon as they confirm the new monthly amount is in place, you thank them and end the call.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.overpayment_id: 958173a6-276a-4cb2-a6bd-923239bf5747. Basis: the only overpayment on her profile (find_overpayments), status waiver_pending; the tool docstring asks for the overpayment the request was lodged for. Uniqueness: no other overpayment exists.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.waiver_request_id: 141b733e-e124-4e32-89a6-b8c2b5a9bfe7. Basis: "A waiver request that reached review without the household's annual income stands incomplete, and the claimant completes it" - the request returned by find_overpay_waiver_requests carries annual_household_income 0.00 and status received. Uniqueness: it is the only request on the overpayment.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.annual_household_income: 31701.20. Household of one (request household_size 1), so the income is worked out from the records over the three-month window back from 2025-10-21. Benefit dating (method, cross-difficulty claim): a supplemental payment (62.00, issued 2025-08-12) falls in the window, so payments are counted by week of benefit: only the 235.00 paid for the week ending 2025-08-02 counts (the 225.00 of 2025-07-22 and the 62.00 are for the week ending 2025-07-19, before the window); issue-date counting would give 522.00. Earnings for weeks ending 2025-07-26..2025-10-18: 12 x 682.00 + 300.00 = 8,484.00. Annualized (235.00 + 8,484.00) x 4 = 34,876.00. Earned-income deduction: average hours 386 / 13 = 29.69, at least 20 -> full share 5% of 33,936.00 = 1,696.80. Support excluded (cross-difficulty withhold): current child-support order 30.00 a week x 52 = 1,560.00. Other pay: no pension, holiday pay 176.00 reported -> added once. Tax excluded: active federal election, 23.50 withheld from the counted payment x 4 = 94.00. 34,876.00 - 1,696.80 - 1,560.00 - 94.00 + 176.00 = 31,701.20.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.overpayment_id: 958173a6-276a-4cb2-a6bd-923239bf5747. Basis: the overpayment under waiver review (find_overpayments, status waiver_pending). Uniqueness: the only overpayment.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.waiver_request_id: 141b733e-e124-4e32-89a6-b8c2b5a9bfe7. Basis: the request under review, now carrying the income completed at step 11. Uniqueness: the only request.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.decision: partially_granted. Basis: "above it and at or below the partial-waiver percent the waiver share of the waivable principal is waived, rounded to the cent, and the rest stays in recovery" and "A request is granted only when the amount waived is the whole unpaid principal; when an amount above zero but less than the whole unpaid principal is waived the request is partially granted" (policy rule); the docstring maps partially_granted to "an amount above zero but less than the whole unpaid principal is waived and the rest stays in recovery". The percent 202.56 is above the full-waiver percent 200 and at or below the partial-waiver percent 250. Uniqueness: granted needs the whole unpaid principal 2,300.00 waived (here 1,619.20 is waived), denied needs more than 250, received leaves the request undecided while the decision is owed.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.waived_amount: 1619.20. Income percent: 31,701.20 / (15,650.00 + 5,500.00 x 0) x 100 = 202.56.
